definition.explanation: From the FI month on, every earned income stream stops; planned expenses and passive income keep running as the Scenario states them. Tax keeps running: each Tax Levy still tallies the income that remains and settles on its own dates, so tax is charged on what is left after earned income stops. The 25x figure is a reference beside a reachable date, never the decision: it compares the assets that are not locked and not marked illiquid in the FI month with 25 times the planned expenses of the next twelve months, and when met is false those assets are below that level, which says the portfolio is short of the rule of thumb, not that FI is out of reach.
